```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(Hmisc)
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}
met_data <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_data.RData") %>%
  select(ADORA2A:YWHAZ)
```


```{r}
met_transpose <- as.data.frame(t(met_data))
# met_genes <- met_transpose[,-1]
# rownames(met_genes, )<- met_transpose[,1]
```


```{r}
# Calculate dissimilarity matrix
distance <- dist(met_transpose, method = "euclidean")

# Perform hierarchical clustering
cluster <- hclust(distance, method = "complete")


png(file="testcluster.png", width=1200, height=700)

plot(as.dendrogram(cluster), main = "complete")

dev.off()
```



```{r}
options(digits = 7)
#create matrix of correlation coefficients and p-values
matrix <-rcorr(as.matrix(met_data), type=c("spearman"))
corvalues <- as.data.frame(matrix[3])
```
